research.scope: P3 common predicate AST/parser (4.03.1.2); typed compile/eval (4.04.3) follows separately; no catalog/engine integration
research.question: Preserve SQL precedence, source/marker ownership and bounded parser/AST construction without recursive boolean chains; separate complete static typing from short-circuit evaluation.

observations.finding: Explicit OR, AND, NOT precedence in ascending binding order.
observations.adopt: Use the XADB EBNF precedence as separate parser layers.
observations.reject: No broader PostgreSQL operators or grammar copied.

observations.finding: makeAndExpr/makeOrExpr append same-operator children into a BoolExpr argument list.
observations.adopt: Store n-ary Or/And and parse repeated siblings with loops; source order retained.
observations.reject: No lappend linked-list implementation or recursive owned AST copied.

observations.finding: Optional Transform_null_equals rewrites equality with NULL into a NullTest.
observations.reject: XADB ordinary NULL comparison stays UNKNOWN; never rewrite x=NULL into IS NULL.

observations.finding: Ordinary operator transformation transforms both operands before make_op.
observations.adopt: Later typed compiler inspects both original operand types before payload conversion/evaluation.
observations.reject: Actual catalog operator resolution is not introduced into raw predicate parser.

observations.finding: transformBoolExpr visits and coerces every argument before constructing the semantic BoolExpr.
observations.adopt: Full static name/type/marker validation precedes runtime short-circuiting.
observations.reject: No early false/true branch suppresses static errors.

observations.finding: coerce_to_boolean can request an implicit assignment cast and rejects invalid set-returning expressions.
observations.adopt: Keep typing as an explicit phase separate from grammar and evaluation.
observations.reject: XADB does not adopt implicit boolean coercion or bare boolean-value predicate grammar.

observations.finding: Precedence places OR below AND below NOT, with comparison/future operators at stronger precedence.
observations.reject: LIKE, IN, BETWEEN, scalar parentheses and broad expression grammar remain outside this leaf.

observations.finding: IS NULL construction can replace known non-NULL constant expressions with truth constants.
observations.reject: Raw XADB parser preserves complete syntax and scalar source; no constant folding before validation.

observations.adopt: Validate an explicit bounded parse depth before recursion.
observations.reject: XADB depth counts active NOT/Group only; long flat AND/OR lists instead consume node/token/source limits.

observations.finding: exprCodeTargetAndOr emits branches and may skip one runtime operand.
observations.adopt: Short-circuit is an execution concern after complete type validation.
observations.reject: Do not copy VM register or expression reordering design into XADB raw parser.

observations.finding: sqlite3ExprIfTrue represents AND/OR/NOT with branches and explicit NULL jump handling.
observations.adopt: Later evaluation must retain explicit T/F/U and NULL comparison semantics.
observations.reject: Do not introduce recursive binary-owned trees or conflate NULL with false.

adoption_boundaries: New independent parse_predicate wrapper shares ParseInput/AstBuilder/markers with future P4 WHERE; no synthetic source prefix or test-only AST bypass.
Always store Predicate→Or→And wrappers, parent-before-child; Group contains Or; n-ary boolean siblings are iterative.
Guard NOT/Group active depth64 before recursive descent; native stack256KiB new acceptance covers deepest success/failure and8192 flat nodes.
Private Compare(Eq) placeholder precedes existing name/scalar children; private set_kind finalizes operator. Existing scalar algorithm remains unchanged, returns its already-computed Span.
All retained and old/new coexist capacity remains charged to caller shared session8MiB/DB64MiB; same source1MiB/node8192/marker256 contracts.
Contextual future words stay names; unsupported forms recognized only at explicitly proposed feature positions.
research.limitations: Source inspection informs an independent XADB design; it does not establish identical DBMS behavior or execute any parser. D2 adoption and product execution remain separate.
